protocols.purpose: Discover component role, actions, limits, dependencies and proof state
Route bounded work between ecosystem components
Return allow, deny or confirm decisions before governed action
Bound time, tokens, cost, files, bytes, subprocesses and external calls
Move curated context without copying entire private state
Record durable outcome/lesson events with provenance and retention class
Describe produced files/data/models with hashes, media types and lineage
Record bounded execution outcomes without private model reasoning
Normalize liveness, readiness, degradation and dependency state
Emit privacy-bounded metrics and traces with request correlation
Declare protocol versions produced/consumed and incompatible changes
Transfer responsibility between components with explicit next owner and evidence
Machine-readable refusal/denial receipt for unsafe or unauthorized action
Describe source/test/package/deploy evidence for a release claim
